summary: The diff implements WeakSet.prototype.delete in its own file, in spec order. this_weak_set(agent, this)? covers steps 1-2 (RequireInternalSlot with a propagated TypeError). Step 3 calls can_be_held_weakly on args[0] and returns Boolean(false) when it fails. Step 4 is done as a keyed delete on the weak-set table via collection_key, which the spec's NOTE allows as an implementation choice. Step 5 returns false when nothing was deleted. No branches on test-specific inputs, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The helpers come from support::collections and were not in the diff, so I could not read their bodies. My clean verdict rests on their names, the successful build, and the test262 result (+32, 0 regressions). The stub's NOTE comment was dropped and the spec-comment formatting was simplified; both are cosmetic.
